scenes.headline: How a norm gain can tell a layer its depth
scenes.sub: LayerRoPE: one shared gain, scaled and turned by layer
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sextant! Deep Transformers waste their later layers. This paper fixes that by changing nothing but the normalization weights.

scenes.label: What's new
scenes.text: Every layer's norm gain is built from one shared vector, scaled by a power law in depth and rotated pair by pair like rotary embeddings.
scenes.mark: scaled by a power law in depth
scenes.say: Instead of a separate gain for every layer, one shared vector is scaled by a power law in depth, and rotated pair by pair, the way rotary embeddings rotate queries.

scenes.title: One layer's gain

parts.note: the gain layer l actually uses
parts.say: The gain a layer uses is built, not stored.

parts.note: length: a power law in depth
parts.say: A magnitude term sets its length, as a power law in the layer index.
A rotation term turns each pair of channels, fast for the first pair and slow for the last.

scenes.say: Four scalars per site, sixteen for the whole network.

steps.say: Each block reads the residual stream through a norm. Here the read gain shrinks as the layer gets deeper.
The block's output passes a new write gain, which the trained model turns up with depth.
So late layers stay loud enough to matter, and the stream ends up wider, not narrower.
The paper's picture: three residual streams, thickened by their variance.
With the learned schedule the stream ends at about four times Pre-Norm's variance, reads scaled down, writes scaled up.

scenes.title: Compute to reach Pre-Norm's 1.3B loss
scenes.say: The three point four times saving reproduces from the paper's own plot. But the older fixes already save two times, so against the best of them it is about one point six.

scenes.label: still training, at a width of only 128
scenes.note: deeper models are also bigger here
scenes.say: It keeps training at five hundred and twelve layers, in models only a hundred and twenty eight wide.

scenes.text: The depth-scheduled magnitude, especially the louder writes, does the work; the rotation adds little.
scenes.say: The part that does the work is the magnitude schedule, especially the louder writes. The rotation adds little, in the ablation and in Llama's own weights.

recap: Damp the reads, amplify the writes
scenes.say: One shared gain. Quieter reads, louder writes. A real but modest win.
